section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the 4-item Subjective Happiness Scale (Lyubomirsky & Lepper, 1999), its item format and scoring (mean of items with one reverse-coded). It reports that internal consistency (Cronbach's alpha = .89) was good for both US and non-US samples, indicating multiple sample subsets are referenced in this section.
section_summary.evidence_source: "Participants completed the Subjective Happiness Scale (Lyubomirsky and Lepper 1999) ... An overall score of subjective happiness is computed as the mean of all items, following reversecoding of one item." "Internal consistency coefficients for this scale were good for both the US and non-US samples (Cronbach's alpha in both cases = .89)."
